description: Bulk enable or disable monitors for an organization. This endpoint is in beta and may change. Use when you need to enable or disable multiple monitors at once based on filters.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for bulk enabling or disabling an organization's monitors.

enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable the monitors.
enabled.title: Enabled

id.description: The ID of the monitor you'd like to query.
id.title: Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project.description: The IDs of projects to filter by. `-1` means all available projects. For example: `/?project=1234&project=56789` or `/?project=-1`
project.title: Project

query.description: An optional search query for filtering monitors.
query.title: Query

inputSchema.title: MutateAnOrganizationsMonitorsRequest

name: mutate_an_organizations_monitors

MonitorDetails.description: Individual monitor details in the response.

alertRuleId.description: Alert rule identifier associated with this monitor.
alertRuleId.title: Alert Rule Id

conditionGroup.description: Condition group configuration for the monitor.
conditionGroup.title: Condition Group

dataSources.description: Data sources associated with this monitor.
dataSources.title: Data Sources

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the monitor was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

dateUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the monitor was last updated.
dateUpdated.title: Date Updated

latestGroup.description: Latest group information for the monitor.
latestGroup.title: Latest Group

openIssues.description: Number of open issues for this monitor.
openIssues.title: Open Issues

owner.description: Owner information (user or team) for the monitor.
owner.title: Owner

projectId.description: Project identifier associated with this monitor.
projectId.title: Project Id

ruleId.description: Rule identifier associated with this monitor.
ruleId.title: Rule Id

workflowIds.description: Workflow identifiers associated with this monitor.
workflowIds.title: Workflow Ids

MonitorDetails.title: MonitorDetails

MutateAnOrganizationsMonitorsResponse.description: Response schema containing a list of mutated monitors with their updated states.

monitors.description: List of monitors that were updated with their new enabled/disabled state.
monitors.title: Monitors
